related.description: Karabiner-Elements is a powerful tool for customizing keyboards on macOS
Karabiner (KeyRemap4MacBook) is a powerful utility for keyboard customization.
⌨️ Open-source keyboard layout text converter for macOS — fix text typed in wrong layout. Double-Shift hotkey, 5 layouts, greedy line detect...
To help gophers generate QR Codes with customized styles, such as color, block size, block shape, and icon.
